message: The aspect '{0}' applied to {2} '{1}' cannot add an aspect of the same type to {4} '{3}' because this {4} has already been processed by aspects of this type. An aspect can add an aspect of its own type only to a declaration that is processed later, such as a member or a parameter of its target.
rationale: The current message misses a word ('is not contained the'). It is also inaccurate: PipelineStepsState.AddAspectInstances compares pipeline steps, which are ordered by the depth of the target declaration, not by containment, so a declaration that is not contained in the target (for instance a derived type) is accepted. The new text states the actual rule and gives the way forward.
